request.query: supremum of a set in a conditionally complete linear order

items.name: le_csSup_iff'
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot α] {s : Set α} {a : α},
  BddAbove s → (a ≤ sSup s ↔ ∀ b ∈ upperBounds s, a ≤ b)

items.name: csSup_le'
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot α] {s : Set α} {a : α}, a ∈ upperBounds s → sSup s ≤ a

items.name: ConditionallyCompleteLattice.csSup_le
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_5} [self : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] (s : Set α) (a : α),
  s.Nonempty → a ∈ upperBounds s → sSup s ≤ a

items.name: isLUB_csSup'
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot α] {s : Set α}, BddAbove s → IsLUB s (sSup s)

items.name: IsClosed.isGreatest_csSup
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace α] [OrderTopology α]
  {s : Set α}, IsClosed s → s.Nonempty → BddAbove s → IsGreatest s (sSup s)
